note: Preregistered BEFORE any baseline or candidate result is produced under this pilot. No universal profitability threshold is invented (none exists anywhere in canonical governance; see SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md section 6.1). These rules govern DEVELOPMENT-zone candidate retention only -- they are not OOS PASS/FAIL criteria (see SSC1D_WP1_oos_decision_contract.json for that, separately).

primary_criterion.rule: candidate expectancy_R must improve versus the frozen SSC v1.0.0 baseline computed on the same DEVELOPMENT dataset

safeguards.rule: candidate N >= 70% of baseline N (guards against retention via sample-shrinkage artifacts)

robustness_requirement.rule: An isolated parameter optimum is not sufficient grounds for RETAIN. A candidate must show reasonable support in its neighboring parameter values (i.e. nearby parameter settings must not collapse the improvement), consistent with SSC_ONE_DAY_DEMO_PILOT_V2.md section 8's preference for stable parameter neighborhoods over isolated maxima.

evaluation_status: NOT_YET_EVALUATED -- these rules are recorded, not applied. No baseline or candidate has been computed under this pilot as of WP1.
scope_limit: Governs DEVELOPMENT-zone candidate retention/rejection only, per the candidate ledger schema (SSC1D_WP0_candidate_ledger_schema.json). Has no bearing on, and must not be conflated with, the separate OOS decision contract.
